name: journali-advisor
description: The service of a journali product advisor: the chat window for a website and MCP for AI agents. It asks journali through its API with the token of the advisor and needs no database of its own. Runs from the journali image; set up the advisor in journali first (Export, Product advisor) and issue a token there.

paths.name: Data
paths.description: What the advisor learns (lernen.json) and optionally the token as a file

ports.name: Service
ports.description: Port of the service; the reverse proxy forwards the public address here

variables.name: JOURNALI
variables.description: Address of journali as this container reaches it: the address of the Unraid server in the network and the port of the app journali

variables.name: JOURNALI_ADVISOR
variables.description: Key of the advisor in journali

variables.name: JOURNALI_ADVISOR_TOKEN
variables.description: Token of the advisor (ja_...); empty if JOURNALI_ADVISOR_TOKEN_FILE is set

variables.name: JOURNALI_ADVISOR_TOKEN_FILE
variables.description: Instead of the field: path of a file with the token, e.g. /daten/token

variables.name: JOURNALI_ADVISOR_DATA
variables.description: Directory for what the advisor learns, matching the path Data; empty: memory only

variables.name: JOURNALI_PROXY
variables.description: 1 behind a reverse proxy: the visitor address comes from X-Forwarded-For; otherwise all visitors count as one
